answer: An exchange selling horizon images, tide forecasts and comet tracks could require a fresh burn for every earning key each epoch. Admission checks a finalized destroyed output, records its ID as consumed, and binds the permit to that key and epoch; copies and expired permits fail. Every added alias costs another burn, including aliases run by parallel colluders. The burn must exceed the maximum extra reward allowed per key. This assumes honest finality and an enforced reward ceiling. Newcomers get a free practice lane, but face the same burn to earn and may be priced out.
